tips.dashboard_text: You are browsing a real environment in read-only mode. Explore freely — every write action is disabled on this account. You can switch the interface language in Settings → Profile.
tips.players_text: Live status of every player (Linux, Android, Windows, BrightSign, ChromeOS…), groups, LAN sync and alerts. In real life you would reboot, update or control screens from here.
tips.media_text: Videos and images are transcoded automatically on upload (renditions, thumbnails). Folders, tags, AI generation and stock photos live here too.
tips.playlists_text: Content loops with per-item duration, multi-zone templates and staged publishing — players update gracefully, in sync. New: nest a “rotation” playlist that plays only N items per loop (in order or shuffled without repeats).
tips.schedules_text: Programs decide what plays where and when: weekly rules, priorities, validity windows, targets (players, groups, sites, site groups). The unified calendar shows everything that plays: visual and audio programs, events and campaigns. Filter by type or by target (site group, site, player) — the CSV export follows your filters.
tips.events_text: Timed or triggered takeovers on top of the regular programming — flash sales, launches, recurring spots.
tips.sites_text: Stores with opening hours drive automatic screen power on/off (works even offline). Site groups target whole regions, and each site can carry an ad occupancy cap and a screen rate for campaigns.
tips.campaigns_text: Sell share-of-voice to advertisers: SOV inventory with per-screen caps and overbooking guard, per-screen pricing with automatic quotes, deterministic delivery, signed proof of play and white-label reports.
tips.approvals_text: The content validation loop: a submitted campaign is reviewed with full context — playable creatives, quote, occupancy of the targeted screens — before it can be published. Approve, reject or request changes, with a full comment history.
tips.advertisers_text: Each advertiser gets a media folder and can receive portal accounts: they follow their campaigns in autonomy and create new ones in self-service — always validated by your team.
tips.reports_text: Executive dashboard, network health, certified proof-of-play and white-label PDF reports with protected share links.
tips.portal_home_text: This is what YOUR advertisers see: their campaigns only. They open their delivery reports and build new campaigns themselves (sites on the map, creatives, live quote) — which you validate before airing.
tips.portal_new_text: The advertiser builds their own campaign: sites on the map, share of voice (or private screens), uploaded creatives, live indicative price — then the retailer validates before anything airs.
tips.portal_report_text: Real airtime measured by signed proof-of-play: plays, share of voice served vs sold, per-screen and per-day breakdowns — exportable as a white-label PDF.
tips.templates_text: Multi-zone screen layouts (main zone, banners, tickers) with a WYSIWYG editor and per-template canvas resolution (FHD, 4K, portrait, custom LED).
tips.audio_baskets_text: In-store audio: music and announcement baskets mixed by ratio, automatic ducking, and a LAN Store Control Panel for the staff.
tips.vod_text: Videos pre-cached on same-site players for instant playback on demand — including an HDMI input switch on compatible BrightSign players.
tips.governance_text: National / regional / local layers compile into one program per screen: head office keeps control while stores keep autonomy on their layer.
tips.iam_text: Fine-grained RBAC: 11 system roles, custom roles, groups with org/site scopes, per-module permissions, 2FA.
tips.updates_text: Version catalog and targeted deployments (org, site, group, single player) with beta channel, staged canary rollout, pause/resume and progress tracking.
tips.notifications_text: Webhook alerts on what matters: player offline, failed deployment, feed error, campaign started/ended/under-delivered.
tips.messaging_text: The AI assistant is also reachable from Telegram: linked users can query the network and trigger actions from their phone, with their own permissions.
tips.ai_keys_text: Each organization plugs its own AI provider keys (Anthropic, fal.ai, ElevenLabs) — AI features run on the customer's accounts, never on shared ones.
tips.security_text: Two-factor authentication, API keys with scopes, session policies and audit log — everything a security team expects.
tips.profile_text: Display name, interface language (5 languages) and Telegram link for the Jeanine assistant. On a demo account, writes stay disabled.
tips.studio_text: Describe a campaign in one brief: the AI creative director turns it into visual concepts, then generates each one in the formats you pick — a ready-to-use bundle in your media library (your own AI keys).
tips.promo_text: Product promo posters: pick a template, background and product shot, type slogan, price and legal lines. Text and prices are composited deterministically — never by AI — pixel-perfect even in 4K.
tips.url_display_text: Show a live web page (dashboard, website) full-screen, schedulable like any media — with offline fallback and an alert if the site becomes unreachable.
tips.feeds_text: RSS/Atom, weather, crypto, reviews… rendered as tickers or card carousels (9 display modes), with moderation and offline cache — schedulable like any media.
tips.provisioning_text: Get new screens on air fast: provisioning tokens, single or batch payloads (per-machine network, CSV import), auto-provision USB keys and BrightSign SD cards.
tips.tags_text: A shared taxonomy (language, region, audience…) to route content automatically: tag media and playlist items, give each player its filters — the same playlist adapts itself to every screen.

playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.picker_landing_hint: Showing the 3 most recent of each type — search or pick a folder to see more
playlists.preview_nothing_to_show: Nothing to preview in this playlist.
playlists.stage_note: Layout preview — each zone runs on its own timer, from the start of its loop. Not replayed here: rotation, campaign spots and tag filtering; zone videos are muted.
playlists.conformance_generating: This content ({src}p) exceeds the target players' capability ({target}p). An FHD rendition is being generated — players will switch to it automatically once ready.
playlists.conformance_exists: This content ({src}p) exceeds the target players' capability ({target}p). An FHD rendition is already available — players use it automatically.
playlists.unpublished_changes: Unpublished changes — players keep playing the published version until you publish.
playlists.no_items: No items. Add media to build this playlist.
playlists.delete_confirm: Remove this item from the playlist?
playlists.template_hint: A multi-zone template plays each zone simultaneously. Assign each item to a zone below.
playlists.delete_playlist_confirm: Delete this playlist? This cannot be undone.
playlists.sync_hint: Players start at the wall-clock position
playlists.sync_windowed_hint: LAN-syncable across a group: broadcast rules apply equally to all players (default scope), so every player shows the same items at any instant — with a brief graceful re-sync at each rule boundary. A per-target rule override would break this.
playlists.sync_ready_hint: Wall-clock mode with known item durations — safe for LAN sync.
playlists.sync_not_ready_hint: Frame-accurate LAN sync isn't guaranteed: the playlist runs in loop mode, has items without a known duration, has broadcast rules, or contains non-conformant media. Normal playback is unaffected.
playlists.rules_hint: Limit when this item plays. An item without a rule plays at all times.
playlists.rule_perpetual_hint: This item plays whenever the playlist is on air.
playlists.rule_validity_hint: Outside this date range the item never plays.
playlists.rule_local_time_note: Local time (player time zone), not an absolute UTC instant like an embargo.
playlists.rule_overrides_hint: A player or group can follow a different rule (most specific wins: player > group > default).
playlists.sub_picker_hint: Nest a playlist inside this one. Depending on its Rotation setting, it plays all its items each loop, or only N per loop (the next ones on the next loop).
playlists.rotation_draft_hint: These settings follow the draft: they only reach the screens when you publish.
playlists.rotation_hint: When this playlist is nested inside another one, this setting defines how many of its items play on each loop. In shuffle mode, no item repeats until all have played.
playlists.doc_pages_title: Pages to play, e.g. "2-5,8" (empty = all pages, in order)
playlists.doc_pages_hint: Pages to play — empty = whole document. Examples: 1-3 (pages 1 to 3) · 1,4,7 (specific pages) · 2-5,8 (mixed) · 5,2 (order kept: page 5 then 2). The duration applies to each page.
playlists.touch_nav_resume_title: Seconds without a touch before the screen leaves the document and resumes normal playback. Empty = 60 s.
playlists.touch_nav_hint: (visitors can swipe or tap to change page; no effect on a non-touch screen)
playlists.no_ads_hint: When this playlist is nested inside a program, its contents play as one block: no campaign spot is inserted between them (the spot lands before or after the block). This reduces ad slots — the campaigns' "achievable SOV" accounts for it.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.lan_sync_warn: This playlist is not syncable (loop mode or items missing a duration), but the selected targets include LAN-synced players. They will drift out of sync. Use a wall-clock playlist with known durations.
schedules.hdmi_incompat_warn: This playlist contains an “HDMI input” item: it will never play on {players} (no physical HDMI input). Those players will skip it in the loop.
schedules.baskets_empty: Add one or more baskets to this program.
schedules.alert_exempt: Alert — triggered, excluded from the mix %
schedules.trigger_emergency: Alert — triggered button, loops until stopped (no %)
schedules.trigger_jingle: Jingle — automatic recurrence (set on the basket, no %)
schedules.governance_node_hint: Attach this program to a governance layer. You must administer the node (or an ancestor) to edit it.
schedules.targets_governed_note: This program is governed by the selected node — the targets below NARROW the node's screens (they can never add any).
schedules.targets_governed_all: No target: this program covers the whole node “{node}” ({count} screen(s)).
schedules.targets_governed_resolved: {count} screen(s) kept out of {total} in the node ({targets} target(s)).
schedules.targets_governed_out_of_scope: Outside the node's scope, these targets keep no screen: {names}
schedules.targets_governed_lan_split: ⚠️ LAN sync group “{group}” is split: {kept} will get this schedule, {excluded} will not. Those screens stay in sync with each other but will no longer play the same thing.
schedules.daysim_intro: Full programming of a player over a day: which programme/event plays (video) and which audio baskets are mixed, with priorities — exactly as it will be resolved at playback.
schedules.daysim_timezone: Times shown in the screen's local time ({tz})
schedules.daysim_empty_video: No video programme active that day.
schedules.daysim_empty_audio: No audio basket active that day.
schedules.daysim_audio_note: Programmed server-side mix (≤100% budget cap applied PER family: music and ambiance are 2 simultaneous layers). Announcements (message) and alerts (emergency) are triggered on-site and do not appear here. On-site, an operator may also adjust some percentages if allowed — the live mix can therefore differ.
schedules.daysim_footnote: Programme view (resolution level). Item-by-item detail is available in the playlist simulation.
schedules.validity_hint: Leave empty for an open-ended programme. The programme only runs within these dates (in addition to the recurrence rules).
schedules.delete_confirm: Delete this schedule? This cannot be undone.
schedules.storage_unknown: {count} screen(s) could not be checked (capacity not reported).
schedules.storage_hint: These screens will only play part of the content. Lighten the playlist or remove them from the targeting.

ab.title: Audio Baskets
ab.assignment_moved: Playout to players is managed in Schedules (audio program).
ab.ratio_bounds_hint: Guard-rails for auto-balancing: the operator can never push this basket below min or above max.
ab.governance_hint: Attach this basket to a node of the delegation tree (§XVIII).
ab.name: Name
ab.rule_hint: Limit when this track plays (local time). No day/time = always.
ab.player_empty: No active track to play in this basket.
ab.picker_landing_hint: Latest audio content ({total} total) — search or pick a folder to browse everything.
ab.ducking_hint: Message/jingle/emergency baskets duck the music. Music/ambiance baskets are ducked.
ab.delete_force_confirm: Delete anyway? The basket will be removed from those broadcasts.

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.intro: Found a bug or have an idea? Tell us — it helps improve Vitrail.
feedback.placeholder: Describe what happened, what you expected…
feedback.error: Could not send. Please try again.
feedback.screenshot_hint: Attach images by clicking, dragging, or pasting (max 8).

updates.served_hint: BrightSign and ChromeOS update with the server. Declare a version to pin it to your players via a deployment — nothing is applied without your deployment.
updates.import_hint: Import a player archive (linux/rpi/windows/android) from the distribution page (URL) or by file. It is stored on THIS server; players download it from here.
updates.intro: Register player versions and deploy them to your fleet — no update is applied without your explicit approval.
updates.deploy_hint: Deploys the version to the selected target (canary workflow: test group first, then whole organization), applying the options above.
updates.windows_hint: Local site time (HH:MM-HH:MM). Players download in the download window (resumable) then only install/reboot in the install window. Empty = anytime.
updates.delete_error: Deletion failed (the version may be used by a deployment).
updates.promote_hint: Validated on the test group? Promote this version: it becomes the fleet reference for its platform.
updates.dep_delete_error: Deletion failed — only cancelled, paused or finished deployments can be deleted.
updates.min_fw_hint: Minimum BrightSign firmware (BOS) required by this renderer version. Players below it first receive the pinned firmware of their family; the renderer is held back until the device reports the required BOS. If no pinned firmware matches, the deployment is refused with instructions.
updates.st_unknown_hint: No version published for this platform: the server cannot tell whether this player is up to date.
updates.st_degraded_hint: This screen could not load its pinned renderer ({version}) and fell back to an older one. Restart it once the server is reachable.
updates.engine_intro: Updates the Electron runtime of the Linux, Raspberry Pi and Windows players. The server downloads the official Electron release, checks its checksum and serves it to the players. A player that does not confirm rendering within 5 minutes goes back to its previous engine on its own, and the deployment stops at the first failure.
updates.engine_deploy_hint: Choose the target and, if needed, the time windows above, then deploy a version. Try a beta engine on one player first; once the server operator promotes it, deploy it to the whole fleet.
updates.engine_not_operator: The server operator chooses which engine versions are available. You deploy them to your own screens.
updates.engine_beta_one_player: A beta engine can only be tried on a single player (target: Player) until the server operator promotes it.
updates.engine_beta_row: Beta: try it on a single player (target: Player), or ask the server operator to promote it.
updates.engine_no_version_for: No engine version for this player's platform ({os}).
updates.deploy_no_target: Deployment #{id} created, but it targets no player (platform or target).

portal.subtitle: Advertiser portal
portal.campaigns_hint: Live view of your campaigns on the network — click one to open its delivery report.
portal.new_campaign_hint: Pick your sites, share of voice and creatives — the retailer validates your campaign before it airs.
portal.exclusive_hint: Your content takes 100% of the ad time on the targeted screens for the period.
portal.choose_sites: Broadcast sites (click on the map or the list)
portal.availability_tight: Inventory is tight on some sites
portal.availability_full: Inventory is full for this period — lower the share of voice or change dates
portal.sov_achievable_warning: The requested share of voice ({sov}%) exceeds what the targeted screens can actually deliver (~{max}%).
portal.spots_achievable_warning: The requested rate ({spots} spots/h) exceeds what the targeted screens can air (~{max}/h).
portal.upload_hint: JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP4, MOV or WebM — {size} MB max per file, {count} creatives max. Each creative is reviewed by the retailer.
portal.submit_hint: The retailer reviews your campaign (creatives included) before anything airs.
portal.in_review_hint: Campaign under review by the retailer — it can no longer be edited.

campaigns.kind_audio_hint: Audio spots inserted into the in-store music rotation (players with an active music basket).
campaigns.kind_audio_badge: Audio campaign — spots in the music rotation
campaigns.spots_achievable_warning: {spots} spots/h requested but only {max} spots/h remain sellable on the worst targeted screen (per-screen cap).
campaigns.audio_cap_hint: Maximum ad spots per hour per screen (org default, overridable per site/screen).
campaigns.audio_rate_hint: Default audio rate: € per spot/hour per day per screen (quote). Empty = no quote.
campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet — create the first one to monetize your screens.
campaigns.calendar_hint: Campaign bars over the month (color = effective status) with the daily inventory load on top — worst player of the day, sold SOV. Amber ≥ 80%, red > 100% (same thresholds as the occupancy check).
campaigns.import_hint: Import an advertiser insertion order (JSON file — see docs/FORMAT_IMPORT_CAMPAGNE.md). The order is checked first (targets by name, creatives, SOV occupancy), then created as a DRAFT: creatives are downloaded in the background and publishing stays manual.
campaigns.import_schema_error: The file does not match the expected format.
campaigns.import_download_note: Creatives are downloaded in the background, then transcoded — check their status in the media library.
campaigns.import_occupancy_note: import stays possible (draft) — publish will enforce the limit.
campaigns.target_map_title: Pick target sites on the map
campaigns.target_map_hint: Click a site to select it (blue = selected). Applying replaces the campaign's SITE targets with this selection; other target types are kept.
campaigns.target_audio_hint: Audio campaign: only "Audio only" or "Content + Audio" players (and sites/groups containing at least one) are offered.
campaigns.target_map_unplaced: {count} site(s) without coordinates — place them in the site form, or target them via the dropdowns.
campaigns.portal_access_hint: External read-only accounts: the advertiser signs in on the same login page and only sees THEIR campaigns and reports (/portal).
campaigns.portal_remove_confirm: Remove {email} from this advertiser's access list? (the account stays deactivated — a new invite will recover it)
campaigns.portal_password_once: Initial password — shown only once, send it to the advertiser:
campaigns.portal_linked_existing: Existing account linked to the advertiser (roles replaced by Advertiser).
campaigns.no_creatives: No creatives — add at least one to publish.
campaigns.scope_empty_hint: No media in this advertiser's folder yet — upload there or switch to the whole library.
campaigns.report_share_hint: Read-only link to this report, no login required — send it to the advertiser. Optional password and expiry; revocable anytime.
campaigns.report_pop_note: Every play is backed by a timestamped Proof of Play, Merkle-chained and signed by the screen (Ed25519) — verifiable at any time.
campaigns.create_hint: Save the campaign, then add its creatives.
campaigns.occupancy_warning: High occupancy on some targeted players
campaigns.occupancy_override: Force publishing anyway (org admin, explicit overbooking)
campaigns.sov_achievable_warning: Requested SOV {sov}% exceeds the achievable ~{max}% on {player}
campaigns.sov_achievable_hint: Loop of {items} items (~{minutes} min): at most 1 spot per loop boundary — beyond that, the campaign will be under-delivered.
campaigns.inventory_hint: Share of voice sold per player over the next 30 days (approved campaigns).
campaigns.default_rate_hint: Organization default SOV rate: € per 1% share of voice per day per screen. Used for the indicative price (quote) — override per site or per player. Empty = no quote.
campaigns.quota_creatives_hint: Maximum number of creatives per campaign uploaded from the advertiser portal.
campaigns.quota_size_hint: Maximum file size (MB) for a creative uploaded from the advertiser portal. Files are re-encoded for delivery anyway.
campaigns.approval_toggle_hint: Every new creative must be approved before it can air — including ones added to an already-validated campaign. Approving a request in Approvals also approves its pending creatives.
campaigns.picker_needs_duration: Duration required: at least one selected image has no native duration.
campaigns.portal_demo_hint: For prospects: full read-only, demo banner and guided info bubbles in the portal.
campaigns.industry_categories_hint: Categories power competitive exclusion: an advertiser carries a category, a site can exclude categories (Sites page) - its screens then leave that advertiser's inventory.
campaigns.industry_category_hint: Sites excluding ANY of these categories will never show this advertiser's campaigns.
campaigns.portal_kinds_hint: Controls what the advertiser can create from the self-service portal. You remain free to create any type on the CMS side.
campaigns.category_delete_confirm: Delete category « {name} »? Its advertisers lose the category and site exclusions are removed.
campaigns.max_duration_hint: Maximum duration of a campaign creative in seconds (short-loop guard: a 90s spot cannot honor 15% of an 80s loop). Empty = no limit. Enforced when adding creatives and at publish.
campaigns.portal_players_hint: Allow advertisers to expand a site and pick specific screens in the self-service portal. Exposes the screen names of your sites to external accounts - off by default.
campaigns.import_keys_hint: Machine keys (sfi_) let an agency or advertiser push insertion orders directly: POST /api/v1/campaigns/import/dry-run then /campaigns/import with the key as Bearer token. Same JSON format as this file import.
campaigns.import_key_once: Key shown ONCE - copy it now.
campaigns.import_key_revoke_confirm: Revoke this key? Clients using it will get 401.

target_map.hint_player: Click a site to take all its screens, then refine screen by screen.

admin_delete.cascade_hint: These rows would disappear too, permanently.

admin_delete.nothing_holds: Nothing references it: it can be deleted for good.
